coins.description: Initial reserves. Required: exactly two coins with positive amounts. Order is canonicalized internally to pool denom order (lexicographic).

min_price.description: Optional lower price bound as coin2/coin1 ratio. If set, both this and max_price must contain exactly two coins whose denoms match the pool reserves; keeper normalizes order.

max_price.description: Optional upper price bound as coin2/coin1 ratio; subject to the same rules as min_price. Keeper ensures min_price < max_price and the initial price is strictly within (min, max).

fee_pct.description: Deprecated: fee_pct is the legacy pool swap fee percentage (cosmos.Dec string in [0,1)). Use fee_rate field 11 instead. Migration logic should read this and convert to fee_rate format (two DecCoins, one per reserve denom in canonical order).

min_collateral_ratio.description: Required: minimum collateral ratio per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a LegacyDec string (> 1).

max_leverage_ratio.description: Required: maximum leverage ratio per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a LegacyDec string (> 1).

interest_rate.description: Annual interest rates per reserve denom (APR >= 0). Input may include 0, 1, or 2 entries; keeper normalizes to exactly two entries in canonical pool order.

max_borrow_percent.description: Required: maximum borrow capacity per reserve denom as DecCoins (exactly two, canonical order). Each amount is a LegacyDec in [0,1).

liquidation_threshold.description: Required: collateral ratio liquidation threshold per reserve denom (exactly two, canonical order; each amount is a LegacyDec string > 1)

fee_rate.description: Per-denom swap fee rates (amounts in [0,1)). Allow 0, 1, or 2 entries; keeper normalizes to exactly two entries in canonical pool order. Replaces deprecated fee_pct field 5.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgCreatePool.title: Msg Create Pool
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.MsgCreatePool.description: Create a pool. Behavior: - If min_price/max_price are both unset (or effectively encode [0, +∞)), the   pool behaves as constant product (v2). - If a finite band is provided, concentrated-liquidity math applies within   [min_price, max_price] where price is coin_b / coin_a (see conventions).

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.title: Dec Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.DecCoin.description: DecCoin defines a token with a denomination and a decimal amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Dec which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.
